brief:
## What
Validate and consume the v1 greeting fixture.

## Done when
### Behaviour
- Validate numeric version 1, return the supplied message and reject unsupported versions using the fixed contract {version:1,message:"Hello, Pedro!"}.
- Wait for the producer build and the sandbox external team Dependency. Attach and inspect exact v1 contract proof, then Pedro accepts via board Mark met; closure alone is insufficient.
### Tests
- test/sim-891/consumer.test.mjs: numeric version 1 returns the supplied message; unsupported versions, including string "1", are rejected.
- test/greeting.test.js: existing trimming, named greeting, friend fallback and exercise-switch checks still pass unchanged.

## Scope
### Files
- src/sim-891/consumer.mjs
- test/sim-891/consumer.test.mjs
### Size

### Excluded
- Cross-clone source imports; fixtures carry the contract
- Changes to legacy APIs/tests, index.html or its keyboard behavior
- Services, auth, internet calls, secrets, dependency changes, production deployment and follow-ups
- Implementation before Start build

## Verify
no

## Confirmed
- Pedro confirmed this consumer part after the producer in settled linked delivery.
- The sandbox external team owns the external proof. Pedro alone accepts inspected evidence via board Mark met.
- Export names and rejection details are routine builder choices.

## Notes for the builder
Producer: maddec01/lar-factory-sim-891-s05-a#15. UI: maddec01/lar-factory-sim-891-s05-c#15. Parent release: maddec01/lar-factory-sim-891-s05-a#14.
The external Dependency remains unmet until actual proof is attached, inspected and accepted. No proof has been supplied.
Blocked by: `Produce the v1 greeting fixture`
Consumes: `Produce the v1 greeting fixture`
Produces: `sim-891 accepted greeting`
Contracts: `sim-891 greeting v1`, `sim-891 accepted greeting`
